project: Independent Chinese wordmark design judgment and prospective transfer, not formal poster mainline

generator: ChatGPT first-party image_gen; two serial calls to same available generator; model/version/seed are not externally exposed and must be reported UNKNOWN

A.label: A 中性基线
A.prompt: 任务：制作「纸屿茶舍」中文品牌字标的A版中性基线图。独立一张横向3:2透明背景PNG，主体居中，只有准确的简体中文「纸屿茶舍」四个字，从左到右单行排列，纯黑色，不加其他文字、英文、标志、插画、分栏、道具、外框、阴影、纹理或水印。以规范、端正、均衡、可读的普通宋体印刷文字为造型基线；四字笔画清楚、大小与基线协调、留白充足，不追求艺术化，不加入连笔、共笔、夸张装饰或新笔画。纸必须仍为纟+氏，屿必须仍为山+与，茶不能写成荼，舍不能误写成舎。无字形错误优先于任何审美效果。只生成一张，不生成备选，也不要在图片中放A标签。

B.label: B 统一规则版
B.prompt: 任务：制作「纸屿茶舍」中文品牌字标的B版设计规则试验图。独立一张横向3:2透明背景PNG，主体居中，只有准确的简体中文「纸屿茶舍」四个字，从左到右单行排列，纯黑色，不加其他文字、英文、标志、插画、分栏、道具、外框、阴影、纹理或水印。品牌场景：清新克制、有文化气质的独立茶空间。采用自洽、专业而克制的现代中文艺术字，不直接用默认印刷字体，也不强迫四个字共享同角度或长尾。创作顺序：先确保完整正确的每字部件、笔画和读音，再检查整组高低、疏密与内部白口；对复杂的左右结构保留部件边界，对上下结构保留通透中宫；如有呼应，只在一两处原生笔画收势里形成轻微有机节奏，不画额外装饰笔画，不做故意断裂和密集花纹。纸必须仍为纟+氏，屿必须仍为山+与，茶不能写成荼，舍不能误写成舎；绝不增加独立笔画。优先保证64像素小图仍能自然认字且四字边界清楚。只生成一张，不生成备选，也不要在图片中放B标签。

design_gate_before_reveal.primary: Chinese complete glyph correctness: 纸(纟+氏), 屿(山+与), 茶(艹 and lower components), 舍(人/干/口 structure); assess every image before aesthetic scoring
design_gate_before_reveal.required_visual: No extra lettering, four intact glyphs, no confusion of parts, equal conditions, black-only, transparent
design_gate_before_reveal.technical: Source-file byte SHA-256 if accessible; compare visible ink bounding boxes at same ink height; 96/64/32px reading previews; count full vertical blank-column gaps only as manual-review trigger (<3 if wordmark intended separated)
design_gate_before_reveal.negative_controls: If glyph incorrect or output missing, INVALID for that arm; don't reroll. If any output is a design board rather than a stand-alone logo, reject it.
design_gate_before_reveal.aesthetic: Independent human reading/preference requested only if both arms valid. No AI self-scoring can certify independent blindness; no trained skill advancement from a single favorable pair.
design_gate_before_reveal.stop: Do not open a new R30 numbering loop, do not modify existing SVG/vector/Figma or formal mainline; preserve failures.

provenance_boundaries: Both generated images are prospective at this stage; no third-party designer source shapes are copied; not a claim to human-original font engineering or editable vector delivery.
